name: bolster
description: Bolster for construction businesses: AI estimates, jobs, customers, bills, vendor orders, bid requests, the schedule, time, lead forms and job costing, worked from ChatGPT as you.

interface.longDescription:
Bolster is estimating and job management software for contractors and remodelers. Connect your Bolster account to work it from ChatGPT, as yourself and with your own permissions.

What you can do:
- Build a priced estimate with Bolster's AI estimator from a description of the work, site photos, plans or an existing quote.
- Find and edit jobs, customers, invoices, tasks, vendors and catalog items. Change a job's lines, quantities and prices, with every total recalculated by Bolster.
- Enter receipts and vendor bills from a photo or PDF, costed to the right job.
- See how a job is tracking against its budget, and which jobs are over.
- See and adjust the schedule, assign crews and vendors, and log time.
- Create vendor orders and bid requests, and review the bids.
- Manage lead forms and see where leads come from.

Who it is for: contractors, builders and remodelers who run their business in Bolster, and homeowners who want to see their own projects.

Limits: it needs a Bolster account. It only reaches the companies you choose when you connect, and only what your role in each company allows. AI estimates and Smart Build-out use your company's Bolster AI credits. Nothing is sent to a customer unless you ask for it.

What is on the schedule this week?

positive.description: Start an AI estimate from a description
positive.prompt: Estimate a 12 by 14 foot composite deck with stairs and a railing for a new job called Review Deck.
positive.expected_behavior: Starts an estimate in prompt mode and reports progress. When it is ready, it reports the new job with its total, item count and customer options.

positive.prompt: Which of my jobs are still pending?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the company's pending jobs with names, customers and totals, without inventing any.

positive.description: Read a job and change a quantity
positive.prompt: Open the Review Deck job and change the deck boards to 200 square feet.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the job, changes that item's quantity and reports the job's recalculated total.

positive.prompt: How is the Review Deck job tracking against its budget?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports budget, committed, actual and projected cost and margin for that job.

positive.prompt: What is on the schedule this week, and who is assigned?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists this week's scheduled work by day with the assigned crew or vendor, or says the week is empty.

negative.description: Unrelated travel request; Bolster has no travel tools, so it should not be called
negative.prompt: Book me a flight to Denver next Tuesday.

negative.description: General writing request that needs no Bolster data
negative.prompt: Write a short poem about building a deck.

negative.description: Another company's data the user has not connected; the tools only reach connected companies and should report that it cannot see it
negative.prompt: Show me every job at a competitor's construction company.
